topHook: Reply within an hour: ~7× likelier to qualify the lead

scenes.vo: [calm, curious] Reply to a new lead within an hour, and you're nearly seven times more likely to get a real conversation with the buyer than if you wait even an hour longer.
scenes.label: likelier to qualify the lead

scenes.vo: That's from more than a million leads, at forty-two US companies.
But when researchers tested over two thousand companies, just over a third replied within the hour.
scenes.label: replied within the hour

scenes.vo: [lowered] And almost one in four never replied at all.
scenes.label: never replied

scenes.vo: And a lead that waits goes cold.
